rows.question: what share of serious violent crimes in California are committed by youth under 18?
rows.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN d.age_group = 'Under 18' THEN d.offender_count ELSE 0 END) / SUM(d.offender_count), 1) AS pct_under_18, SUM(CASE WHEN d.age_group = 'Under 18' THEN d.offender_count ELSE 0 END) AS under_18_offenders, SUM(d.offender_count) AS total_offenders FROM summary_offender_demographics d WHERE d.state = 'CA' AND d.year BETWEEN 2021 AND 2025 AND d.ucr_offense_code IN ('09A','11A','11B','11C','120','13A') LIMIT 1000

rows.question: Which state has the highest murder rate?
